_note: Hand review of the generated cloze cards for the Official Secrets Act, 1923. This Act's PDF interleaves its amendment footnotes with the section text more aggressively than any other book in the corpus, so a higher share of cards is rejected here than elsewhere — the apparatus filter in make_cards.py catches the obvious ones and these are what it did not.
